A_p2a_disconnect_recovery.note: Opened raw streaming request, read a little, closed mid-stream, then issued short generation on same replica.

headline: P2a (4 tokenizer workers) removes the 1M-preprocessing /ping tail: A p99 1.7ms vs B 1.67s; 1M-body tokenization 21% faster; streaming TTFT and disconnect delivery revalidated clean (no Granian regression).
method: Direct loopback A/B on both replicas. Load = /v1/messages/count_tokens with 5,299,733-byte body rendering 990,819 input tokens (same filler fixture as P1, 23,042 reps). Oracle = /ping (lightweight liveness route, confirmed 200 ~1.6ms baseline) + concurrent short /v1/chat/completions (max_tokens 8). During-load samples taken while the count_tokens thread was tokenizing.

public_smoke.note: Authenticated chat completion through the public tunnel path; key supplied from the operator keychain, value never printed.

streaming_revalidation.note: Consecutive warm stream:true chat completions (max_tokens 150). Earlier single 15s first-chunk on A was one-time cold decode-graph capture after the recreate.
